meta.title: BayReno — Renovation & Refurbishment in Munich | Bayerische Renovierung
meta.description: BayReno: renovation, refurbishment, painting and flooring in Munich and the surrounding area. On schedule, clean, from one provider — combinable with moving and clearance.

hero.headline: Renovation with Bavarian craftsmanship — on schedule and clean
hero.subheadline: From cosmetic repairs to full refurbishment: BayReno brings apartments, houses and commercial space in Munich to the condition you need — with fixed dates and one point of contact.

items.title: Painting & wallpapering
items.body: Walls and ceilings painted, papered and filled — properly masked, low-dust working.

items.title: Flooring
items.body: Laminate, vinyl, parquet and tiles: laid, sanded or replaced.

items.title: Bathroom & plumbing
items.body: From replacing individual fixtures to a complete bathroom rebuild.

items.title: Kitchen
items.body: Assembly, conversion and connection — including adapting to existing connections.

items.title: Drywall & electrics
items.body: New partition walls, suspended ceilings, wiring and lighting renewed via specialist partners.

items.title: Full refurbishment
items.body: All trades coordinated: one schedule, one contact, one handover date.

steps.title: Inspection
steps.body: We look at the space and agree exactly what condition it should be in at the end.

steps.title: Fixed quote
steps.body: You receive a transparent quote with a clear scope of work — no surprises.

steps.title: Binding dates
steps.body: We set the start and completion dates, and we stick to them.

steps.title: Execution
steps.body: Clean working practices, floors and furniture protected, daily site cleaning.

steps.title: Handover
steps.body: A joint walkthrough and handover — we're only finished when you're satisfied.

combo.headline: Strongest in combination
combo.body: BayReno works hand in hand with Super Umzug and Super Entrümpelung. When a property first needs clearing, then renovating, then moving into, we coordinate every step through one contact — saving you time, coordination and vacancy.

items.question: What does a renovation cost?
items.answer: It depends on floor area, condition and the standard you want. After a short inspection you receive a fixed quote — you're also welcome to ask our chat assistant or request a callback.

items.question: How long does a renovation take?
items.answer: Cosmetic repairs are often done within a few days; a full refurbishment takes several weeks depending on scope. We give you the binding timeframe with the quote.

items.question: Can I stay in the apartment during the work?
items.answer: For individual trades, yes. For a full refurbishment we recommend moving out — or we work room by room so you can stay.

items.question: Do you take on small jobs too?
items.answer: Yes. We also handle single rooms, touch-ups and cosmetic repairs before a handover.

items.question: Do you work for property managers and landlords?
items.answer: Yes, that's one of our specialities. For recurring work we offer fixed partner rates and priority scheduling — see B2B & Partners.
